name: Build A Keyboard!
desc:
Welcome to Build a Keyboard!

- 💻 Roll and collect rare keycaps
- 👷 Hire workers to automate your farm
- ⚙️ Upgrade and expand your keyboard setup
- 💰 Earn cash and climb the leaderboards

Remember, your keyboard earns while you're offline!

The game is new, so there might be some bugs.
Like the game and join the group for rewards!
